text:
Nina (PM): quick sync — Q3 sprint planning: we need to finalize launch gates for enterprise audit + BYOK scope. putting constraints on the table.
Kevin (Eng): ok. what are the hard gates vs nice-to-have?
Nina (PM): hard: immutable audit stream, customer-managed keys for export, retention toggle per-tenant. nice: indexable full-text search on old audit data, archiving cold-tier UI.
Elaine (Security): SOC2 asks: proof of tamper-resistance + key rotation policy. we need KMS attestation + HSM compatibility documented.
Jordan (SRE): capacity note — immutable stream + high-cardinality indexing doubles storage IOPS. if we want 99.9% ingest, need separate ingest cluster or pre-filtering.
Sam (Sales): customers pushing for BYOK day-one for pilots. if we delay, we lose two deals. they also require 3 months of logs searchable.
Kevin (Eng): timeline-wise, we can do a BYOK MVP (server-side envelope keys + export path) in 6 wks if we cut search and RBAC UI. full HSM integration is ~12wks.
Nina (PM): proposal: ship BYOK MVP + immutable stream + retention toggle for initial launch. postpone indexable search to phased deliverable. document tradeoffs.
Elaine (Security): acceptable if we include cryptographic hash chaining for audit entries and key rotation procedure in docs. need threat model updated.
Jordan (SRE): operational gate: runbook for hot-path backfill + legal-hold escape hatch (block deletes for specific tenants). also need alerting for any failed writes to immutable store.
Nina (PM): launch criteria draft: 1) immutable stream with hash chaining. 2) BYOK MVP that supports customer-provided RSA/ECC keys for export. 3) retention toggle + legal-hold flag. 4) keystore access audit and KMS attestation doc.
Kevin (Eng): dev tasks: a) implement append-only S3 topic with prefix locks. b) sign each record with chain hash: sha256(prev||record). c) BYOK handshake: wrap keys with our KM wrapper. sample config snippet for retention matrix below:
Kevin (Eng): ```
retention_policy:
  tenant_tier: enterprise
  default_ttl_days: 90
  legal_hold: false
  archive_after_days: 180
  export_allowed_with_byo_key: true
```
Sam (Sales): can we expose a SLA note for retention costs? that'll help contracts.
Nina (PM): add cost estimate to PRD. Jordan — can you prototype ingest cluster sizing and give a 95th percentile cost estimate by EOD Thursday?
Jordan (SRE): yes. will use current telemetry and a 2x safety factor.
Elaine (Security): I'll draft the KMS attestation checklist and required controls. also: require access logs for key usage for 180 days.
Kevin (Eng): blockers: need API for tenant-level legal-hold (non-deletable TTL override) and a migration plan for existing logs (transform to chained format). migration will need a maintenance window or streaming re-signing job.
Nina (PM): decision needed: do we force migration pre-launch or provide a compatibility shim? leaning shim to unblock customers. thoughts?
Elaine (Security): shim ok if auditability preserved and we flag legacy entries. mustn't weaken tamper proof guarantees.
Kevin (Eng): shim approach: keep legacy records readable but add a bridging signature on next write. not ideal but much faster.
Sam (Sales): shim + clear note in contract should be fine for pilots.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled config rollout for staging retention matrix at 2023-11-02T07:00:00Z (info only)
Nina (PM): action items: Jordan — sizing estimate Thu. Elaine — KMS checklist Thu. Kevin — prototype chain hashing + legal-hold API spike next week. Sam — consolidate customer deadlines by Fri. I'll update PRD with these gates and circulate for review. :thumbsup:
